product_launches.description: Fountain has recently added its Copilot and agent-driven AI capabilities to automate routine hiring and workforce management tasks in the background while keeping humans in control of key decisions.

press_references.value: Fountain Launches Cue to Run Frontline Hiring and Workforce Operations

product_launches.description: Fountain launched Cue, an autonomous frontline intelligence system embedded in its platform to run hiring and workforce operations tasks such as sourcing, screening, and scheduling for frontline workers.

press_references.value: Fountain Reinvents the Frontline Worker Hiring Funnel with AI: ‘Pool’ and ‘Source’ to Help Employers Find Qualified Workers Faster and Lower Acquisition Costs

product_launches.description: Fountain launched two new capabilities, Pool and Source, within its Frontline OS platform to use AI for talent rediscovery and sourcing optimization, helping employers find frontline workers faster and reduce recruiting spend.

press_references.value: Fountain Shift Uses AI to Streamline Scheduling, Compliance and Time Tracking

product_launches.description: Fountain announced new AI-driven enhancements to its Fountain Shift product, adding automated scheduling, compliance management, and time tracking features for frontline workforces.

press_references.value: Fountain Launches Frontline OS to Cut New Hire Screening Time of Frontline Workers by up to 98% and Boost Retention by 50% Through Agentic AI

product_launches.description: Fountain launched Frontline OS, an AI-native operating system that automates hiring, onboarding, scheduling, compliance, and workforce management for frontline teams, powered by its Copilot using Anthropic’s Claude models.

about_short_description.short_description: Fountain is a talent platform that develops to make workforce management and hiring easier.

product.name: Fountain Frontline OS
product.description: An AI-powered workforce management platform that connects frontline hiring, onboarding, scheduling, and workforce operations in one system.

product.name: Cue
product.description: An orchestration layer that coordinates Fountain workflows and AI agents for hiring, onboarding, candidate support, and frontline operations.

product.name: Fountain Hire (Applicant Tracking System)
product.description: An applicant tracking system for managing high-volume applications, screening, interviews, communications, and offers from application through hire.

product.name: Fountain AI Recruiter
product.description: An AI recruiting agent that conducts voice-based candidate screening, answers questions, evaluates responses, and schedules qualified applicants for interviews.

product.name: Fountain Sourcing
product.description: A candidate sourcing solution that combines job boards, talent pools, candidate matching, and re-engagement campaigns to build applicant pipelines.

product.name: Fountain CRM
product.description: A recruiting CRM for managing past applicants, talent communities, automated outreach, and re-engagement workflows.
